name: PM-KISAN
summary: ₹6,000/year direct income support in 3 instalments to all land-holding farmer families.
benefits: ₹2,000 every 4 months directly to bank account
No middlemen — transferred via Direct Benefit Transfer
Applicable to all small & marginal farmers
eligibility: All farmer families with cultivable land. Excludes income-tax payers and government employees.
howToApply: Visit nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) or apply at pmkisan.gov.in with Aadhaar and bank details.

name: PMFBY
summary: Subsidised crop insurance covering losses due to natural calamities, pests, and diseases.
benefits: Premium as low as 1.5% for Rabi, 2% for Kharif crops
Full coverage even for prevented sowing
Claims settled within 2 months of harvest loss
eligibility: All farmers growing notified crops. Compulsory for loanee farmers, voluntary for others.
howToApply: Apply through nearest bank, CSC, or insurance company before crop sowing deadline.

name: PMKSY
summary: Ensures water to every farm — 'Har Khet Ko Pani, More Crop Per Drop'.
benefits: 55% subsidy on drip/sprinkler irrigation for small & marginal farmers
45% subsidy for other farmers
Installation support and training provided
eligibility: All farmers. Priority for water-stressed regions and SC/ST communities.
howToApply: Contact District Agriculture Officer or apply via state agriculture portal.

name: KCC
summary: Flexible credit up to ₹3 lakh at 4% interest per year for farming needs.
benefits: Credit up to ₹3 lakh at just 4% annual interest
Covers seeds, fertilisers, pesticides, equipment
Flexible repayment aligned to harvest cycle
Includes personal accident insurance cover
eligibility: All farmers, sharecroppers, oral lessees, and SHG members in agriculture.
howToApply: Apply at any nationalised bank, cooperative bank, or Regional Rural Bank.

name: TNAU Seed Subsidy
fullName: Tamil Nadu Agriculture University Certified Seed Distribution
summary: Subsidised high-yield certified seeds for paddy, pulses, oilseeds, and vegetables.
benefits: Up to 50% subsidy on TNAU certified seeds
High-yield, disease-resistant varieties
Available for Kharif and Rabi seasons
eligibility: All farmers in Tamil Nadu with valid Uzhavar Seithigal (Farmer ID) card.
howToApply: Contact nearest District Agriculture office or Primary Agriculture Cooperative Society (PACS).

name: SMAM
summary: Subsidy on farm machinery — tractors, tillers, harvesters, pump sets and more.
benefits: 40–50% subsidy on approved farm equipment
Additional 10% for SC/ST farmers
Custom Hiring Centres set up in villages
eligibility: Individual farmers and Farmer Producer Organisations (FPOs).
howToApply: Apply online at agrimachinery.nic.in or at District Agriculture office.

name: Soil Health Card
summary: Free soil testing and personalised fertiliser recommendations for your farm.
benefits: Free soil sample testing every 2 years
Card showing NPK and micronutrient levels
Crop-specific fertiliser recommendations
Reduces input costs by 10–20%
eligibility: All farmers across India. No restrictions.
howToApply: Contact local Agriculture Extension Officer or visit soilhealth.dac.gov.in.
documents: Land details — village and survey number

name: TN Horticulture Subsidy
fullName: Tamil Nadu Horticulture Development Agency Schemes
summary: Subsidies for banana, coconut, mango, flower, and vegetable cultivation in Tamil Nadu.
benefits: 50–75% subsidy on planting material
Support for drip irrigation in orchards
Post-harvest infrastructure support
eligibility: Farmers in Tamil Nadu cultivating horticultural crops.
howToApply: Contact District Horticulture Officer or TANHODA office.

name: PMMSY
summary: Support for fisheries and aquaculture — boats, nets, and pond construction subsidies.
benefits: 40% subsidy (general), 60% subsidy for SC/ST/Women
Covers fish pond construction, aerators, and feed
Insurance coverage for fishing vessels
eligibility: Fishers, fish farmers, SHGs, FPOs engaged in fisheries.
howToApply: Apply via state fisheries department or pmmsy.gov.in.

name: RKVY
summary: State-level agricultural development — farm ponds, storage, technology, and FPO support.
benefits: Funding for farm ponds and storage structures
Technology demonstrations and FPO support
Agriculture extension and training programmes
eligibility: Benefits reach farmers through state-implemented projects.
howToApply: Contact District Agriculture offices and state agriculture departments.
documents: Contact local agriculture office for specific project requirements

name: Rythu Bandhu
summary: ₹10,000 per acre per year to farmers in Telangana for investment support.
benefits: ₹5,000 per acre for Kharif season
₹5,000 per acre for Rabi season
Direct Bank Transfer to farmers
eligibility: All land-owning farmers in Telangana.
howToApply: Submit land ownership proof (Pattadar Passbook) to local agriculture extension officer.

name: KALIA
fullName: Krushak Assistance for Livelihood and Income Augmentation (Odisha)
summary: Financial support to small/marginal farmers, landless agricultural households, and vulnerable agricultural families in Odisha.
benefits: ₹4,000 per year for small/marginal farmers
₹12,500 for landless agricultural households
Life insurance cover of ₹2 Lakh
eligibility: Small/marginal farmers, landless agricultural workers in Odisha.
howToApply: Apply online at kalia.odisha.gov.in or through Gram Panchayat.

name: Bhavantar Bhugtan Yojna
summary: Compensates farmers for the difference between the Minimum Support Price (MSP) and the actual selling price in mandis.
benefits: Price deficit directly credited to bank accounts
Reduces market risk for selected crops
eligibility: Farmers in Madhya Pradesh selling registered crops in APMC mandis.
howToApply: Register on MP E-Uparjan portal during the registration window.
deadline: Announced seasonally by the state government

name: MKUY
summary: Capital investment subsidy for setting up commercial agro-enterprises.
benefits: Capital subsidy up to ₹50 Lakh
Encourages food processing, dairy, and poultry ventures
eligibility: Individuals, partnerships, FPOs, and NGOs in Odisha.
howToApply: Apply online through APICOL portal.

name: Saur Sujala Yojana
summary: Provides solar-powered irrigation pumps to farmers at highly subsidized rates.
benefits: Subsidized solar pumps (3HP and 5HP)
Reduced dependence on grid electricity and diesel
eligibility: Farmers in Chhattisgarh with existing borewells/open wells without grid connection.
howToApply: Submit application to the state's agriculture department or CREDA office.

name: MMKAY
summary: Financial assistance to farmers to improve agricultural production and reduce debt dependence.
benefits: ₹5,000 per acre (up to 5 acres, max ₹25,000) per year directly to bank account
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers holding land up to 5 acres in Jharkhand.
howToApply: Apply via CSC centers or local block agriculture office.

name: YSR Rythu Bharosa
summary: Financial assistance for farmer families, integrating PM-KISAN funds.
benefits: Total ₹13,500 per year per farmer family
Includes tenant farmers and ROFR cultivators
eligibility: Land-owning farmers, tenant farmers, and forest land cultivators in AP.
howToApply: Register at the local Village Secretariat.

name: Pani Bachao, Paisa Kamao
summary: Incentivizes farmers to save electricity (and thus groundwater) in agriculture.
benefits: Direct cash transfer for electricity saved below a fixed limit
Encourages crop diversification and micro-irrigation
eligibility: Farmers connected to selected agricultural feeders in Punjab.
howToApply: Enroll at PSPCL offices.

name: Kisan Sarathi
summary: Information and communication technology platform providing right information at the right time in the farmer's desired language.
benefits: Personalized advisory directly from scientists of Krishi Vigyan Kendras (KVKs)
Timely alerts on weather and pests via SMS/WhatsApp
eligibility: All farmers.
howToApply: Register via the Kisan Sarathi portal or through local KVKs.

name: NMOOP
fullName: National Mission on Oilseeds and Oil Palm
summary: Promotes the cultivation of oilseeds and oil palm to increase vegetable oil production.
benefits: Subsidies on seeds, fertilizers, and planting materials for oil palm
Assistance for borewells, drip irrigation, and harvesting tools for oil palm farmers
eligibility: Farmers growing oil seeds or interested in taking up oil palm cultivation.
howToApply: Apply through State Department of Agriculture / Horticulture.

name: PM-KMY
summary: Old age pension scheme for all small and marginal farmers (SMFs) in the country.
benefits: Minimum assured pension of ₹3,000/- per month on attaining the age of 60 years
Family pension equal to 50% of the pension in case of subscriber's death
Matching contribution by the Central Government
eligibility: Small and Marginal Farmers (SMFs) between 18 to 40 years of age.
howToApply: Enroll through Common Service Centres (CSCs) or State Nodal Officers (SNOs).

name: PMMY
summary: Loans up to ₹10 lakh to non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises. Agriculture-allied activities are also eligible.
benefits: Shishu: Loans up to ₹50,000
Kishore: Loans from ₹50,001 to ₹5,00,000
Tarun: Loans from ₹5,00,001 to ₹10,00,000
eligibility: Individuals carrying out allied agricultural activities like dairy, poultry, beekeeping, etc.
howToApply: Apply at banks, NBFCs, MFIs or online at Udyamimitra portal.
